decision: Existing methods cover the core scientific requirement. Prefer RadMatch with its brain-mr examples for finding-level adjudication; use existing RadGraph-XL graphs and GREEN category-c errors for an inexpensive local diagnostic layer. Do not claim the first laterality/location metric.
contribution_position: A brain-MRI-specific, auditable spatial evaluation protocol and curated reference annotations can be a benchmark contribution after validation. Standard set F1/exact match and a new vocabulary alone do not establish a novel metric.

sources.name: HeadCT-ONE
sources.relevance: Ontology-normalized entities and relations; controllable weighted F1 for head CT. Strong prior art for normalized brain-anatomy evaluation. CT-specific extractor and ontology need checking on MRI.

sources.name: RadMatch
sources.relevance: Persists atomic findings, matching, and attribute-level errors; location includes laterality and sub-anatomy. Public implementation has a brain-mr few-shot bundle. Best candidate for a small, independently reviewed pilot; not yet executed here.

sources.name: RadSEM
sources.relevance: Atomic propositions and contradiction-constrained matching. Its published convention expands unspecified paired-organ laterality into two sides, which conflicts with this project's unknown-does-not-mean-bilateral protocol. Do not adopt that convention unchanged.

sources.name: Fine-grained phrasal grounding / RQ
sources.relevance: Explicit finding, anatomy, laterality, and severity patterns; textual pattern P/R/F1 plus image grounding. Direct prior art against claiming first location/laterality-aware measure. Chest X-ray grounding cannot be transferred unchanged to 3D brain MRI.

sources.name: Rad-SpatialNet
sources.relevance: Spatial relationship annotation/extraction resource with brain MRI reports; not itself a turnkey generated-report score.

sources.name: RadFact
sources.relevance: Bidirectional finding-sentence entailment precision/recall. Useful independent factuality evidence; separate side/site tables still require a task-specific breakdown.

sources.name: FineRadScore
sources.relevance: Line-level corrections and error severity. Useful for auditing discrepancies, but not an out-of-the-box fixed brain-region accuracy table.

validation_required_before_publication: Review all 560 reference reports without consulting candidate model predictions; document evidence and unknown fields.
Use one semantic definition for reference and prediction facts, independent of model identity.
Audit extractor accuracy separately from report-generation accuracy, including negation, uncertainty, side/site binding and spatial relation type.
Run the fixed stress pack and the same 24-patient pilot across all 15 selected settings; preserve failures and denominators.
Blind clinician review of sampled predictions, disagreement adjudication, and patient-cluster uncertainty intervals.
Use an independent validation set for a strong novel-metric claim; some current test texts have already been inspected during retrospective development.
